sampling_unit: 12 paired seed lineages plus stratified paired bases; independently resampled natural episodes for K
strata: 8 equally weighted magnitude-panel strata; natural K episodes unstratified
point_source: Frozen per-seed endpoint summaries. F_WITHIN is ratio of cohort E_WITHIN to E_PAIR, not mean seed ratios.
interval_source: Exact saved per-draw statistics; resampling indices not supplied. No regeneration of individual bootstrap draws.
